# kubriX - internal developer platform

> kubriX is a curated, opinionated, yet highly flexible Internal Developer Platform (IDP) distribution, build from predefined bricks for kubernetes
> https://kubrix.io

description: >
  kubriX transforms scattered cloud-native tools into a cohesive Internal Developer Platform (IDP) 
  that enables faster, safer, and more efficient software delivery. It brings together open-source 
  building blocks for delivery, security & compliance, observability, and developer experience into 
  a consistent and integrated solution.

## Key Features
- [kubriX platform](https://kubrix.io/): kubriX platform - deliver software faster, with ease

- [Hub & Spoke Architecture (kubriX Prime feature) | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation/hub-and-spoke-basics): In topologies where you want a central management cluster operating many workload clusters, we speak of a Hub & Spoke model.

## Documentation Sets
- [Quickstart kubriX on a local KinD cluster | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation/kind): With this step-by-step guide kubriX with its default stack gets deployed on your local KinD cluster.
- [Troubleshooting | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/troubleshooting): 
- [Troubleshooting during Installation | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/troubleshooting/installation-troubleshooting): Keycloak degraded
- [Onboarding applications | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/user-guide/onboarding-apps): When your team creates applications with some specific conventions which applies to the platform ApplicationSets, then your app is automatically deployed via a platform ApplicationSet and you don't need to deal with any ArgoCD application definitions.
- [Onboarding teams | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/user-guide/onboarding-teams): New teams can simply onboard themselves by executing the 'team-onboarding' template or by clicking "Choose" in the "Team-Onboarding" template here//backstage.demo.kubrix.cloud/create
- [Promoting changes with Kargo | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/user-guide/promoting-changes): When you want to make changes to your applications Kubernetes resources you can simply click "View sources" on your components overview page. Use the "umbrella" application and not the stage specific application for this!
- [kubriX Roadmap | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/roadmap): We are constantly developing kubriX and carefully listen to our customers challenges and requirements.
- [Onboarding teams and apps | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/user-guide/onboarding-additional-infos): According to the ADR Onboarding teams in a gitops way we are currently working with the approach apps-in-any-namespace and multi-tenant kyverno-policies.
- [Quickstart demo stack on Kubernetes | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation/quick-start-kubernetes): With this step-by-step guide kubriX with its default demo stack gets deployed on your preferred Kubernetes cluster
- [Overview | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/overview): What is kubriX?
- [Production installation | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation/production): ⚠️ We highly recommend using kubriX-prime for production workload and professional services from suXess-it. Still, you can use kubriX OSS also for small production environments without special security or compliance needs at your own risk.
- [kubriX-flavor-templates | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation/kubriX-flavor-templates): background information
- [Installation | kubriX](https://kubrix.io/docs/installation): 📦 Introduction
